subject: Label position on selectInput (drop down box)

messages.author: a89255530e96e85a
messages.subject: Label position on selectInput (drop down box)
parts:
I'm somewhat new to Shiny and was struggling to find a way to label a column of drop down boxes on the left side (same row) as the box itself. My column is created with:

 column(3, h4("Base"),                                                     
       selectInput(inputId = "year0", label = "Box 1", choices = year0Levels, selected="Choice 1"),
       selectInput(inputId = "year1", label = "Box 2", choices = year1Levels, selected="Choice 2"),
       selectInput(inputId = "year3", label = "Box 3", choices = year3Levels, selected="Choice 3"),
       selectInput(inputId = "year5", label = "Box 4", choices = year5Levels, selected="Choice 4")
  ),

I want to have the labels (Box 1, Box 2, etc.) to the left of the input box rather than above each box. Not sure if I can do this by re-positioning the label itself or setting the label to NULL and adding a column of text labels to the left of the column of boxes. Any advice would be appreciated,

Thanks,
Joe
